settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer free 30-day returns on all orders. Items must be unworn and in original condition. Start a return from your account page or email us at support@honorinclothing.com.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days. Expedited options are available at checkout. Orders ship within 1–2 business days of being placed.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Currently we ship to the US and Canada. International expansion is coming — sign up for our newsletter to be the first to know.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Each product page has a full size guide with measurements. When in doubt between two sizes, we recommend sizing up for a relaxed fit or staying true to size for a fitted look.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: We process orders quickly, but contact us within 1 hour of placing your order and we'll do our best to make changes. Once shipped, we're unable to modify the order.
